name: 飛彈不受每次上限
find: uint32_t give = need <= per ? need : per;

name: 艦載機不受每次上限
find:
give = need <= per ? need : per;
    add32w(m, ship_seg, ship_off + 0x12, give);
replace:
give = need;
    add32w(m, ship_seg, ship_off + 0x12, give);

name: 飛彈上限改有號比較
find: uint32_t give = need <= per ? need : per;

name: 艦載機上限改有號比較
find:
give = need <= per ? need : per;
    add32w(m, ship_seg, ship_off + 0x12, give);
replace:
give = (int32_t)need <= (int32_t)per ? need : per;
    add32w(m, ship_seg, ship_off + 0x12, give);

name: 飛彈缺口截成16位元
find: uint32_t need = cap - rd32w(m, ship_seg, ship_off + 0x0E);
